notes: Chainlink TWAP updates over RTDS (wss://ws-live-data.polymarket.com), topics crypto_prices_twap_thirty (30s) and crypto_prices_twap_sixty (60s). Values follow the documentation example. Exact-decimal consumers must use full_accuracy_value, never the floating 'value'. Subscriptions start with the next update; no snapshot, history, or replay after disconnect. RTDS heartbeat: client sends PING every 5 seconds. The 'filters' field of a subscription entry is OPTIONAL -- the official page states 'Omit it to receive every available symbol', and advises filtering on payload.symbol client-side when one window needs several symbols; when present it must be the exact compact JSON form with one lowercase symbol and no spaces (re-verified 2026-08-26). The 'subscribe-request-all-symbols-no-filters' example freezes the omitted-filters form.
